The passing float32 control sparse-03 has 0/512 mismatches and maximum absolute error 1.1920928955078125e-7. Center both sorted and original values by the row maximum before computing the projection. Clamp centered values below -1: they cannot belong to the positive support, since the centered threshold lies in [-1, 0]. This also prevents extreme finite inputs from creating overflowing prefix sums. Input storage, output shape/dtype, and backward handling remain unchanged. Compilation and post-patch runtime correctness could not be verified through the supplied API; the observations describe the original implementation.
